title: Deciphering the Binding of the Nuclear Localization Sequence of Myc Protein to the Nuclear Carrier Importin alpha3.
authors: Rizzuti, Bruno; Iovanna, Juan L; Neira, Jose L
one_liner_zh: 该文结合实验与分子模拟研究Myc转录因子NLS肽段与核转运蛋白Importin alpha3的结合，属于蛋白质-肽段互作而非典型TF-DNA体系，但分子模拟方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: The oncoprotein Myc is a transcription factor regulating global gene expression and modulating cell proliferation, apoptosis, and metabolism. Myc has a nuclear localization sequence (NLS) comprising residues Pro320 to Asp328, to allow for nuclear translocation. We designed a peptide comprising such region and the flanking residues (Ala310-Asn339), NLS-Myc, to study, in vitro and in silico, the ability to bind importin alpha3 (Impalpha3) and its truncated species (DeltaImpalpha3) depleted of the importin binding domain (IBB), by using fluorescence, circular dichroism (CD), biolayer interferometry (BLI), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), and molecular simulations. NLS-Myc interacted with both importin species, with affinity constants of ~0.5 microM (for Impalpha3) and ~60 nM (for DeltaImpalpha3), as measured by BLI. The molecular simulations predicted that the anchoring of NLS-Myc took place in the major binding site of Impalpha3 for the NLS of cargo proteins. Besides clarifying the conformational behavior of the isolated NLS of Myc in solution, our results identified some unique properties in the binding of this localization sequence to the nuclear carrier Impalpha3, such as a difference in the kinetics of its release mechanism depending on the presence or absence of the IBB domain.
abstract_zh: 癌蛋白Myc是一种转录因子，调控全局基因表达并调节细胞增殖、凋亡和代谢。Myc含有一个核定位序列（NLS），由第320位脯氨酸至第328位天冬氨酸残基组成，以允许核转位。我们设计了一个包含该区域及其侧翼残基（Ala310-Asn339）的肽段，命名为NLS-Myc，通过荧光、圆二色光谱（CD）、生物层干涉法（BLI）、核磁共振（NMR）和分子模拟，在体外和计算机模拟中研究其与importin alpha3（Impalpha3）及其截短形式（DeltaImpalpha3，缺失importin结合域（IBB））结合的能力。NLS-Myc与两种importin形式均发生相互作用，通过BLI测得的亲和常数约为0.5微摩尔（针对Impalphas3）和约60纳摩尔（针对DeltaImpalpha3）。分子模拟预测NLS-Myc的锚定发生在Impalpha3对货物蛋白NLS的主要结合位点。除了阐明Myc分离NLS在溶液中的构象行为外，我们的结果还识别了该定位序列与核载体Impalpha3结合的一些独特特性，例如其释放机制的动力学差异取决于IBB结构域的存在与否。
